title: OpenSSL Buffer Overflow
text: A critical buffer overflow vulnerability was discovered in the TLS handshake state machine. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send malformed ClientHello packets across the network to achieve arbitrary code execution. Upgrading to OpenSSL 3.5.2 completely remediates this flaw.

title: Kernel Privilege Escalation
text: Local users on Linux kernels prior to 6.14 can trigger a race condition in eBPF map allocation to escalate privileges to root. A security patch has been backported to all supported LTS branches.
